name: Hive Strike
author: ZadenZ
description: Arena shoot-em-up on Vita. Blast the swarm through 15 stages and three Queen boss fights or chase a high score in Endless mode. Twin, Spread, Shield and Bomb power-ups, per-mode high scores and an original synth soundtrack. No auto fire: tap to shoot, hold for a stream.
requirements: Requires libshacccg.suprx: install ShaRKBR33D once (from VitaDB Downloader) before first launch, then install the vpk with VitaShell.
